headline: Moved forward a zoning amendment on Act 250 conditions in the Form-Based Code district, for an October 27 public hearing.
summary: The commission discussed small changes to natural community and endangered species rules, but no vote was recorded. It moved a zoning amendment on Act 250 conditions toward an October 27 public hearing. Staff also gave updates on the City Center Step 3 designation, agriculture regulation, and the Shelburne Road project.
decisions: Moved a zoning amendment on Act 250 conditions to a public hearing on October 27.
Approved the August 11, 2026 meeting minutes unanimously.

decision_titles: Zoning amendment on Act 250 conditions in the Form-Based Code district
plain_text:
PAGE 1 
SOUTH BURLINGTON PLANNING COMMISSION 
08 SEPTEMBER 2026 
 
The South Burlington Planning Commission held a regular meeting on Tuesday, 
September 8, 2026, at 7:00 p.m., in Room 301, City Hall, 180 Market Street, and via 
Zoom. 
 
MEMBERS PRESENT: J. Louisos, Chair; M. Mittag, D. MacDonald, C. Lawrence, M. 
Emery 
 
ALSO PRESENT: P. Conner, Director of Planning and Zoning; K. Peterson, City 
Planner,  
 
1. Instructions on exiting the building in case of an emergency: 
 
Ms. Louisos provided instructions on emergency exit from the building. 
 
 
2. Agenda: Additions, deletions or changes in order of agenda items: 
 
No changes were made to the agenda. 
 
3. Open to the public for items not related to the Agenda: 
 
No issues were raised. 
 
4. Announcements and staff report 
 
Staff provided updates on city projects to the Planning Commission.  
 
5. LDR Amendments: RTE Language Tweaks Public Hearing  
 
The Planning Commission discussed small changes to the Significant Natural 
Communities and Rare, Threatened, and Endangered Species regulations in the
PLANNING COMMISSION 8 SEPTEMBER 2026 PAGE 2 
LDRs. These included correcting typos and adding “by a qualified professional” to 
the field verification requirement.  
 
6. LDR Amendments: Procedural Clarity in Act 250 Transfer  
 
The Planning Commission moved an amendment to the LDRs for public hearing 
on October 27. This amendment is to update the DRB’s authority to review Act 250 
conditions in the Form-Based Code district.  
 
7. Step 3 Designation: Staff Update  
 
Staff provided an update on the current status of the City’s Step 3 designation 
application for City Center.  
 
8. Update on Agricultural Regulation  
 
Staff provided an update on the current status of the municipal regulation of 
agriculture in Vermont.  
 
9. Shelburne Road Planning Update  
 
Staff provided an update on the current status of the Shelburne Road Planning 
project to the Planning Commission.  
 
10. Minutes: August 11, 2026  
 
J. Louisos moved to approve the minutes of August 11, D. MacDonald seconded. 
Unanimous approval.  
 
11. Other Business  
a. Notice of City of Essex Junction Bylaw Amendments Hearing 
12. Adjourn
PLANNING COMMISSION 8 SEPTEMBER 2026 PAGE 3 
As there was no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting 
was adjourned by common consent. 
 
 
 
    ___________________________________ 
     Clerk
